# Scoping changes like a principal engineer: size to the trigger, decompose never descope (SHORT FICHE)

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @riekelt's principal-engineer scoping-changes skill (requires the principal-engineering background skill). Encodes three disciplines: sizing to the trigger (a fix is as big as the defect that triggered it — no gold-plating, no adjacent improvements riding along, the borderline-addition test, owner can re-scope but not merge scopes), decompose-never-silently-descope (an oversized approved task becomes named parts with the cut line stated, deferred work tracked, partial deliveries labeled honestly), and driving to completion (no "want me to continue?" checkpoints, blocked parts surfaced not stalled, settled decisions stay settled), plus scoping rules for code review in both directions and the common failure modes ("while I'm here", descoping to hit a deadline, fencing unreachable edges).
